name: First-Order Correctness Gradient Approximation
definition: A gradient approximation method that computes the derivative of a pre-filtered function f̂ by averaging the derivative of the original function f over a local interval [x - αε, x + βε]. It guarantees absolute first-order correctness for continuous functions and relative first-order correctness for discontinuous functions.
summary: First-Order Correctness Gradient Approximation is a gradient estimation method for differentiable volume rendering that guarantees first-order correctness by averaging derivatives over local intervals and handling discontinuities via specific composition rules.
